The F-13 gate between intake and assessment: cross-verification, policy checks and the

AuthorityFact.description: What one board resolution for borrowing authorises (BR-01 to BR-04).

AuthorityRef.description: An approving authority: a role or committee, never a person.
AuthorityRef.title: AuthorityRef

BalanceFact.description: One account's balance on a financial-year end, from its statement (FS-02).

CamPart.description: A part of a section, under its subheading: the kind of content it is drafted from.

CamSignOff.description: A line of the sign-off block, left for the people who sign.

CamWordsRequest.description: A section's paragraphs in a person's words, or a copilot redraft a person keeps.
CamWordsRequest.title: CamWordsRequest

CaseCreate.description:
Create a case after the RM confirms (F-04.7). The proposal flow
(F-04) fills `header` with sources; a direct create leaves it empty.
CaseCreate.title: CaseCreate

CaseDeleteRequest.description: F-01.5: why the case is being deleted; kept in the decision log.
CaseDeleteRequest.title: CaseDeleteRequest

CaseProposal.description:
What the pasted message proposes (F-04). Nothing is stored until the
RM confirms and posts a CaseCreate (F-04.7).
CaseProposal.title: CaseProposal

CellEdit.description: A person's figure standing in place of the statement's (the printed one stays beside it).
CellEdit.title: CellEdit

CellInput.description: One figure a derived figure or ratio rests on, with the figures it rests on in turn.
CellInput.title: CellInput

CellSource.description: Where a figure the statement prints was read, and in what unit.
CellSource.title: CellSource

CellWorking.description: How one spread figure was arrived at (F-22.3): where it was read, or what it was worked out from.
CellWorking.title: CellWorking

Classification.description: F-09.4: what was found, how it exited, and the runners-up.
Classification.title: Classification

ComparisonCounts.description:
agree, differ, new, missed and no_deviation_either_side count the deviations area;
to_adjudicate counts every item in either area awaiting a current decision.
ComparisonCounts.title: ComparisonCounts

ConductFlag.description: Something in the accounts for a person to look at. A question, never a decision.
ConductFlag.title: ConductFlag

CoverageRule.description:
What "complete" means for an item beyond presence (F-13.2), always
measured from the case's fixed as_of date (principle 8).
CoverageRule.title: CoverageRule

CrossVerificationView.description:
The cross-verification board for one case (F-19): every finding of the latest run by area,
discrepancies ranked by credit impact within each area, and whether submission is blocked.
CrossVerificationView.title: CrossVerificationView

DisplayUnit.description: The unit financial figures are written in, from the published configuration.
DisplayUnit.title: DisplayUnit

EditTarget.description: What an edit of this figure names.
EditTarget.title: EditTarget

EditableDisplay.description: The unit financial figures are written in.
EditableDisplay.title: EditableDisplay

EditableNorm.description: A norm with its own threshold (eligibility, documentation, security cover).
EditableNorm.title: EditableNorm

EditableRatio.description: A financial-ratio norm's thresholds: acceptable is the norm; marginal is shown beside it.
EditableRatio.title: EditableRatio

EditableSettings.description: What the Administration screen edits, as the published version has it.
EditableSettings.title: EditableSettings

Evidence.description:
Where a value came from (FRD §7, F-16). Page is mandatory (C7); the
region is optional, as normalised page coordinates (0 to 1, top-left
origin): [x0, y0, x1, y1].
Evidence.title: Evidence

EvidenceRow.description: One extracted row behind a headline value, with the page it was read from.
EvidenceRow.title: EvidenceRow

Exclusion.description: A credit removed before counting business inflow (F-18.2).
Exclusion.title: Exclusion

FacilityFact.description:
An existing facility as one source records it (F-19 OB-01): the declaration of existing
facilities, a sanction letter or the commercial bureau report.
FacilityFact.title: FacilityFact

FactValue.description: One source's value for a fact, with where it came from (F-18.6).
FactValue.title: FactValue

FieldValue.description: One extracted value with its evidence and confidence (F-15, F-17).
FieldValue.title: FieldValue

FileRecord.description: Bytes as received (F-05). Every file ends in a visible state (F-05.5).
FileRecord.title: FileRecord

FinancialYear.description: One year's audited statements: their own year and the comparative column.
FinancialYear.title: FinancialYear

Finding.description: A cross-check or policy outcome (F-19, F-20).
Finding.title: Finding

FindingDetail.description: The line-by-line comparison behind a finding: months, people, years.
FindingDetail.title: FindingDetail

GapLeg.description: How far one source is from another: one leg of a comparison.
GapLeg.title: GapLeg

HeaderField.description:
One case-header field with both values kept (F-01.2): what the system
proposed and where from, and what a person confirmed.
HeaderField.title: HeaderField

IncorporationFact.description: The company's incorporation as the certificate of incorporation records it.
IncorporationFact.title: IncorporationFact

LogicalDocument.description: One logical document: a file and a page range (F-08).
LogicalDocument.title: LogicalDocument

MatrixAuthority.description: An approving authority: a role or committee, never a person (F-21).
MatrixAuthority.title: MatrixAuthority

Meta.description: Choice lists the screens need, from config/app.yaml.
Meta.title: Meta

MonthFigure.description: GST outward supplies and cleansed bank credits for one month (TO-05).
MonthFigure.title: MonthFigure

NormComponent.description:
One line a derived figure was summed from, with the sign it carried (F-20.2).

`net worth = share capital + reserves and surplus` shows as two components, each with the
figure read from the statement and the page it was read from.
NormComponent.title: NormComponent

NormInput.description: One source figure a norm used, with where it came from (F-20.2).
NormInput.title: NormInput

Obligation.description: A recurring debit that looks like a loan instalment (F-18.4).
Obligation.title: Obligation

OutputSource.description:
A document the memo or the note cites, numbered in the order it is first cited, so the screen
and the downloads refer to it the same way (F-23.2, F-24.2).
OutputSource.title: OutputSource

Party.description:
A person or entity on the case: director, partner, proprietor,
guarantor or the borrower itself (F-10.2).
Party.title: Party

PartyList.description:
A list of people a document names (F-10.2): the field that holds them and, for a list of
objects, the key of each part. A plain list of names has no `name_key`.
PartyList.title: PartyList

PdNote.description: The PD question note (F-24): ranked questions, each tied to its finding and evidence.
PdNote.title: PdNote

PdPerson.description: Someone to meet: a promoter or director the documents name.
PdPerson.title: PdPerson

PdQuestion.description: One question for the personal discussion (F-24).
PdQuestion.title: PdQuestion

PdRef.description: Another finding a merged question also rests on (F-24.2).
PdRef.title: PdRef

PdTopic.description: The questions asked under one topic, in order.
PdTopic.title: PdTopic

PersonEntry.description: One person as one source names them, with the identifiers printed there.
PersonEntry.title: PersonEntry

PersonSet.description: The promoters one source names (F-18.3: variants resolved later).
PersonSet.title: PersonSet

PolicyGroup.description: One family of norms as the Policy page's overview shows it (F-20).
PolicyGroup.title: PolicyGroup

PolicyNorm.description:
One norm (F-20.1): an expression over POLICY_INPUTS, a threshold, the
deviation category a breach falls under, and its source. A ratio norm
takes its label, unit, direction and threshold from `ratios`.
PolicyNorm.title: PolicyNorm

ProposedField.description: F-04.3: a value is proposed only with its span in the message.
ProposedField.title: ProposedField

QueryItem.description: One line of the pre-login query list (F-14).
QueryItem.title: QueryItem

Readiness.description: F-13.4: weighted proportion satisfied, against the configured gate.
Readiness.title: Readiness

ReferenceApproval.description: The approval as RBL's record states it: a role or committee, never a person.
ReferenceApproval.title: ReferenceApproval

ReferenceDeviation.description: One deviation as RBL's record states it.
ReferenceDeviation.title: ReferenceDeviation

SettingChange.description: One value that changes: where it is, its label, and before and after as raw values.
SettingChange.title: SettingChange

SettingsChanges.description: Only what changes; anything left out stays as published.
SettingsChanges.title: SettingsChanges

SourceColumn.description: One source a finding compared, as a column of its card (F-19.3).
SourceColumn.title: SourceColumn

Span.description: Character offsets into the pasted message: [start, end).
Span.title: Span

SpreadCheck.description:
A statement checked against itself or against the next year's report (F-22.3): the balance sheet's two
totals, or a figure as one year's statements give it and as the following year's give it as its comparative.
SpreadCheck.title: SpreadCheck

SpreadColumn.description: One year of one kind of statement.
SpreadColumn.title: SpreadColumn

StageProgress.description:
One processing stage of FRD §5, as the case workspace shows it (§6).
Counts only, never extracted values, so every role may read it.
StageProgress.title: StageProgress

StatementEditRequest.description: Set a statement line to a person's figure, entered in the unit the statement prints.
StatementEditRequest.title: StatementEditRequest

StrippedSpan.description:
Part of the message set aside before extraction but kept as
provenance (F-04, normalisation): nothing is proposed from it.
StrippedSpan.title: StrippedSpan

TaxYear.description: One income tax return, by the financial year it covers.
TaxYear.title: TaxYear

TurnoverFigure.description: One source's turnover for one financial year (F-18.1).
TurnoverFigure.title: TurnoverFigure

TxnRow.description: One statement transaction and how it was classified.
TxnRow.title: TxnRow

UploadResult.description: F-05.5: every file ends in a visible state; archives list their members.
UploadResult.title: UploadResult

Working.description: One step of the working-capital assessment (F-22.2).
Working.title: Working

XvArea.description:
One area of the board (identity, turnover, bank accounts, existing obligations) as its
overview card shows it, counted from the area's findings of the latest run.
XvArea.title: XvArea

XvDecision.description: A person's decision on a discrepancy, with the comment every decision needs.
XvDecision.title: XvDecision

XvFact.description: One figure on an area's overview card: a short source label and its value.
XvFact.title: XvFact

XvHighlight.description:
A key-figure line on an area's overview card, from one finding: what it compares, the
figures side by side, and a short note ("25.0% apart · tolerance 10%", "declared, no statement").
XvHighlight.title: XvHighlight

XvItem.description: One finding of the latest run, with its review state, as the board shows it.
XvItem.title: XvItem

get.description:
The tolerances, norm thresholds, cross-check rules and approval matrix an Administrator
edits (F-00.6), as the version now published has them.

post.description: What the changes would change and why they could not be published; nothing is published.

Publish the changes as a new configuration version, with the Administrator's note, and
re-run every case's checks (F-00.6). 422 with the problems when they cannot be published.

get.description:
The append-only decision log, newest first, filtered and paged. RBL's reference record
and the reviewer's decisions on it are for the reviewer only (F-25): anyone else sees that
the import, confirmation or decision happened, never what it said.
Every template, the default first, with the parts a new one may draw on.

post.description: A new template, kept bank-wide with who made it and when; never edited in place.

schema.title: Response List Cases Api Cases Get

post.description: F-04: parse a pasted message into a proposed case. Stores nothing.

delete.description:
F-01.5: delete a case and everything it owns, so testing can start
again. An RM may delete only their own cases. The decision log keeps a
record of the deletion; the case ID is not reused.

get.description: F-21: the authority the case needs under the published matrix, and the rules that set it.

post.description:
F-13: create the case, opening cross-verification, policy checks and the outputs.

`review.decide`, because it is the decision that intake is complete: the analyst and the
credit manager hold it, the RM does not.

Refused with 409 while completeness is not satisfied; the body names the blockers so the
screen can say which one. Pressing it twice is harmless: the case is returned unchanged.

get.description: F-23: the draft CAM, every figure cited, ending in the structured summary.

F-23.5: the draft CAM as a Word or PDF file, the same content as the screen, with numbered
citations and the sources; the recommendation is left blank for credit.

post.description: A figure overridden, with the value drafted and the reason, kept with who and when.
The copilot's redraft of a section, for a person to keep or discard; nothing is kept yet.
More data asked for from a section; it goes on the query list.

delete.description: Back to the engine's draft of the section.

put.description: A section in a person's words, or a copilot redraft a person keeps.
The template this case's memo follows; edits stay with their sections across a switch.

get.description: F-25: CreditIQ against RBL's confirmed reference record, deviations and approving authority.

put.description: F-25.4: the reviewer's verdict on a difference or a new deviation, with a reason.

get.description:
F-19: the cross-verification board: every finding of the latest run, the discrepancies ranked
by credit impact with their sources side by side, and whether submission is blocked.

post.description: F-19, F-17.4: accept, dismiss or escalate a discrepancy, with a comment.
F-14: put what would complete a check that could not run on the pre-login query list.

schema.title: Response Case Documents Api Cases  Case Id  Documents Get

get.description:
F-05.6, F-16: the rendered page image (PNG) of a document's source
file; `page` is the absolute page in the file, as in Evidence.
F-18: the aligned facts the cross-checks compare, each with its evidence.

schema.title: Response Case Fields Api Cases  Case Id  Fields Get
Response Case Files Api Cases  Case Id  Files Get

post.description:
F-05: multipart upload, field name "files" (repeatable): single files,
several files or ZIP archives. Registers every file and queues processing.
The body is parsed as it streams, so size limits apply before a file is
held in full.

schema.title: Response Case Findings Api Cases  Case Id  Findings Get

get.description: F-10.2: the case's party set with sources and attributed KYC.

schema.title: Response Case Parties Api Cases  Case Id  Parties Get

get.description: F-24: questions for the personal discussion, ranked, each tied to its source.

F-24.3: the PD question note as a Word or PDF file, the same content as the screen, with room
under each question for the response and the follow-up.
F-20: every norm with its required and actual value, source figures and outcome.

FRD §6: each processing stage's status and counts, for the stage
progress in the case workspace. Counts only, so every role may read it.

schema.title: Response Case Queries Api Cases  Case Id  Queries Get

post.description: F-25.1: the RBL reviewer confirms the imported record (never the person who imported it).

get.description: F-22: the spread (interim layout) with ratios and the working-capital assessment.

post.description:
F-22.3: set a statement line to a person's figure, in the unit the statement prints, with a
reason. The document's own figure is kept beside it; the norms, the memo and the spread all follow.
Put the statement's own figure back; the edit stays in the history.

get.description: The case's statement transactions with their categories, filtered; behind the assessment gate.

Cash, returns, concentration, round trips, balances, salary and statutory payments, promoter flows,
unusual entries and the integrity of the statements, with thresholds from configuration.
Totals by category and by month, and how many rows the rules settled, a person settled, or nothing has.

delete.description: Take a person's decision off a transaction; it returns to how the rules (or the model) read it.

put.description: A person files one transaction under a category, with the reason. The rules are not changed.

get.description: The unit financial figures are written in (config/statements.yaml).

Response Config Versions Api Config Versions Get

post.description:
F-17.5: confirm, correct, waive or assign, with a reason. Recorded as
an overlay; never changes configuration.
